Hexagon’s Manufacturing Intelligence division is growing business and expanding the team in Brazil, therefore seeking for Technical Sales Consultants for its team.

Why Join Us?

Hexagon is the global leader in measurement technologies. We provide confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate. From microns to Mars, our solutions ensure productivity, quality, and sustainability in everything from manufacturing and construction to mining and autonomous systems.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,800 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.4bn EUR.

Learn more at hexagon.com.

Job Description

The Technical Sales Consultants that will join our team are result-oriented with a proven track record of exceeding targets and driving revenue growth. Skilled in building and nurturing strategic client relationships to understand their unique business needs and provide tailored technology solutions. Excel at analyzing market trends, conducting needs assessments, and recommending innovative strategies to optimize customer success. Committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences and surpassing expectations through effective communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.

These positions will be based in our São Paulo office, near the Santo Amaro region. These are Hybrid positions.

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to acquire new clients and expand business with existing accounts, leading to a great increase in revenue year-over-year.
  • Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify sales opportunities in target industries, resulting in a relevant growth in market share.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to assess customer needs, design customized solutions, and present persuasive proposals to key stakeholders.
  • Manage end-to-end sales cycle, including lead generation, qualification, negotiation, contract closure, and post-sales relationship management.
  • Proactively engage with customers post-implementation to ensure optimal solution adoption, customer satisfaction, and identify upselling opportunities.
  • CRM experience and discipline are a must.
  • Successfully achieve and exceed quarterly sales quotas, consistently ranking among the top performers in the region.
  • Cultivate and maintain productive relationships with key accounts, resulting in a strong increase in repeat business.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and deliver compelling presentations to educate customers on the value and benefits of solutions.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop targeted campaigns and drive lead generation initiatives.
  • Actively participate in trade shows and industry conferences to expand the network and generate new business opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Technical Metrology or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Strong sales knowledge understanding of the manufacturing industry, system integrators and related technologies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Professional English, capable of communicating across diverse teams.
  • Proven experience in sales.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients.
  • Excellent customer service skills, building and maintaining strong relationships.
  • Experience in Salesforce or other CRM solutions.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • Works independently as well as in a team environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary with opportunities for growth and development.
  • Benefits package aligned with the Brazilian market.
  • Opportunities to grow and move within a global company known for its commitment to employee growth and innovation.

At Hexagon’s Manufacturing Intelligence, our spirited energy and engagement are evident in our commitment to our work, passion for what we do and the speed at which we achieve it. Here you will find the opportunity to build your career, develop professionally, and explore opportunities across a large, diversified company that prides itself on its innovative spirit and commitment to integrity.

We strive to attract the most talented and dynamic individuals in their fields because our success is in our people! Our culture encourages independent thinking and a team mentality.

About Us

At Hexagon, we do not just measure the world – we define its future.

As the global leader in measurement technologies, we provide the confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate.

From microns to Mars, our solutions drive productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability across aerospace, agriculture, automotive, construction, manufacturing, and mining.

Yet measurement is only the beginning. We bridge the physical and digital worlds with cutting-edge metrology, reality capture, and positioning solutions – making industries and cities safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Looking forward, we are striving to enable our customers to meet sustainability and demographic challenges – ultimately advancing them towards truly autonomous solutions.

Measurement is the foundation of progress. When it has to be right, it has to be Hexagon.

Overseeing the patient journey from screening through treatment across CAR-T therapies You will work cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders to ensure therapies reach patients as quickly and efficiently as possible.

  • product infusion

  • material (starting material, intermediates, and final product)

  • material including CMO storage capacity management

  • experience

About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025 in an oral presentation by Heather Landau, M.D. of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. title: Financial Project Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

As part of Finance Global Business Support, the Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial reports, collaborating with Project Managers on resourcing and discrepancies, and supporting project closeouts. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs (LOE – level of effort, T&E, 3rd party Budget consumption, milestones acceptance, invoicing and cash receipts status)
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • Experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Electrical Commissioning Engineer
description:
Datacenter People is a specialized recruitment company working with the leading data center commissioning and quality services firms in the world.

The Role

  • Provide engineering and technical support to plan, schedule, coordinate and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities.
  • Witnesses the static and dynamic testing of complex electrical systems.
  • Perform Test Procedures.
  • Conduct site observation surveys and prepares field reports on the status of projects and completion of projects with respect to compliance to the plans and specifications.
  • Prepare punch list reports and determines corrective measures for on-site problems.
  • Prepare general condition survey reports.
  • Familiarise oneself with codes, local project regulations, construction practices and the latest equipment functional concepts.
  • Obey all the projects safety requirements including specific on-site regulations.
  • Act as project coordinator with other field engineers, coordinating printing, presentation and administration procedures.
  • Review shop drawings and submittals.

The Experience Profile

  • Experience of commissioning electrical systems in a data center or large commercial/industrial setting – typically 500kVA or above. OR Experience in a senior commissioning role with the ability to interpret the same, in lieu of this a technical background.
  • Ability to determine and interpret data from various sources such as external PQM waveforms, data logs etc.
  • Ability to determine pass/fail criteria.
  • Conversant in data center topologies across varied designs: N+1, N+2, 2N etc.
  • Fault finding/trouble-shooting knowledge of various integrated systems such as UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, high and low voltage power systems
  • Working knowledge of network and communications – Modbus/ethernet, SCADA systems etc.
  • Understanding of data center commissioning levels and the requirements to move from level-to-level.
  • Knowledge of scheduling/planning/reporting.

title: HVAC Commissioning Engineer
description:
Datacenter People is a specialized recruitment company working with the leading data center commissioning and quality services firms in the world.

Our client serves as an owner's representative, specializing in Data Center commissioning and QA/QC services.

The Role

  • Provide engineering and technical support to plan, schedule, coordinate and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities.
  • Witnesses the static and dynamic testing of complex mechanical systems.
  • Perform Test Procedures.
  • Conduct site observation surveys and prepares field reports on the status of projects and completion of projects with respect to compliance to the plans and specifications.
  • Prepare punch list reports and determines corrective measures for on-site problems.
  • Prepare general condition survey reports.
  • Familiarise oneself with codes, local project regulations, construction practices and the latest equipment functional concepts.

  • Experience of commissioning mechanical systems in a data center or large commercial/industrial setting – typically 500kVA or above. OR Experience in a senior commissioning role with the ability to interpret the same, in lieu of this a technical background.

  • Ability to determine pass/fail criteria.
  • Conversant in data center topologies across varied designs: N+1, N+2, 2N etc.
  • Fault finding/trouble-shooting knowledge of various integrated systems such as HVAC systems, Refrigeration, Air Handling Units, Chiller systems, Cooling units
  • Working knowledge of network and communications – Modbus/ethernet, SCADA systems etc.

title: Profissional Back End java - SR
description:
Código da vaga: 51972

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei Profissional Back End java - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Habilidades Principais:

  • Responsabilidades: Desenvolvimento e manutenção de funcionalidades, APIs, sistemas e bancos de dados; monitoramento e suporte (APIs/SQL); acompanhamento e implantação em esteiras (API, Liquibase, Maestro); participação em ritos ágeis; entendimento de histórias de usuários; planejamento, reporte técnico e gestão de atividades no Jira, assegurando qualidade nas entregas e testes.
  • Formação: Graduação em Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação ou Análise de Sistemas.
  • Tecnologias e Ferramentas: Java 11+; frameworks Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Batch, Integration), Hibernate, Camel; integração com serviços Rest; gerenciadores de API (Apigee, API Gateway); banco de dados SQL Server, Oracle e MongoDB; criação e manutenção de Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Jobs; DML e DCL; Design Patterns; arquitetura; monitoramento com Dynatrace; containers (Docker, EKS, AKS, Kubernetes).
  • Metodologias e Colaboração: Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); ferramentas colaborativas (Jira, Confluence); práticas de DevSecOps (Integração Contínua, Jenkins, Git, Sonar, Fortify).
  • Diferenciais: Certificações em Cloud (AWS, Azure); inglês e espanhol.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido (3x presencial/semana) na região de Santo Amaro - SP.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

#ElasSabem #SejaVocê #DeMachosaHomens #EntreRaças #Além

Missão do cargo:

Gerenciar o desenvolvimento da melhoria de qualidade dos produtos e segurança de alimentos das fábricas e cadeia logística da Bimbo QSR no Brasil por meio de gestão de indicadores e processos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos globais e locais referente a Qualidade e Segurança de Alimentos em todas as plantas e operações de co-manufatura;
  • Será o principal canal de comunicação com o Corporativo e com outros gestores de qualidade e segurança de alimentos dos diversos países em que temos operação, para o alinhamento estratégico da área e benchmarking;
  • Responsável por implementar programas e sistemas de Gestão de Qualidade e Segurança de Alimentos nas fábricas da Bimbo QSR no Brasil com base em normas reconhecidas pelo GFSI, legislação vigente e requerimentos de clientes;
  • Responsável pela elaboração / revisão e aprovação de orçamentos (CAPEX e OPEX), das áreas de Qualidade e Segurança de Alimentos para as fábricas;
  • Interface e influência com as áreas de P&D, Operações, Compras, Planejamento, Logística e Vendas para o sucesso da implementação dos programas estabelecidos;
  • Responsável pelos indicadores de Qualidade e Segurança de Alimentos nas fábricas e implementação de melhorias que sustentem os resultados a longo prazo;
  • Responsável por desenvolver e implementar sistemas de monitoramento de matérias-primas e embalagens, processo e produto acabado, que garanta a qualidade do produto no ponto de venda e ao consumidor;
  • Monitoramento de fornecedores de Matérias Primas, Embalagens e Serviços;
  • Responsável por implementar auditorias internas/externas e garantir implantação dos planos levantados pelas plantas;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo nas áreas de Química, Biologia, Engenharias, Alimentação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiencia Qualidade, preferencialmente em indústrias de alimentos, bebidas ou pet food.
